meta.title: BiblePath cities and towns
meta.scope: Named settlements in the 66-book Protestant canon. This is a broad source index, not an exhaustive catalogue of every biblical place.
changes: Selected STEP Place records classified as settlements by linked OpenBible records; ambiguous non-settlement classifications omitted. Nearby-place coordinate approximations are not used to classify a place.
Retained source identities and canonical verse references from named, spelling, Aramaic and Greek rows; excluded group-only, LXX and uncertain name forms.
Normalized reference subparts to single verses; deduplicated verses and aliases.
Generated short descriptions from structured reference fields only. No source AI biographies, map coordinates, geometry or images used.

Kept source-combined geographical identities with explicit notes, except Cana/Kanah separated on explicit source name-form verses. Generic descriptive aliases and Babylon regional alias labels are omitted from name matching.
Excluded verse-zero Psalm superscriptions from numbered passage links; the complete source record remains linked.
